gaps.quote: so the cost at parameter $m^k$ is $O(V(m^k)^\theta)$ when $s \ge W$

gaps.term: geometric sum dominated by its last term at s = W
gaps.quote: The levels form a geometric sum dominated by its last term
gaps.note: The page says the bound holds when s >= W. At s = W the ratio s/W is 1, so theta is 0 and every level costs V. The sum is then kV, which is not dominated by its last term and is not O(V). The reader cannot verify the claim at equality.
